english.title: Cause obstruction of an engine / carriage using the railway by act / omission / neglect
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), by

(A)_[an unlawful act,]_
(B)_[a wilful omission or neglect,]_
(C)_[aiding or assisting in an unlawful act,]_
(D)_[aiding or assisting in a wilful omission or neglect,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE ACT / OMISSION / NEGLECT..), caused to be obstructed an engine or carriage using the railway at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36 of the Malicious Damage Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
unlawful act / wilful omission / neglect
or aiding / assisting unlawful act / aiding wilful omission / neglect
caused to be obstructed an engine/carriage using railway
intent is NOT a required element of this offence

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
